description: Returns a link to the OwnYourAgent request form (the agreements card (afsprakenkaart) as a form) with the chosen starting phase, topic and, optionally, Ownership Check IDs pre-filled. It contains no personal data and submits nothing: the person opens the link, checks the answers, adds their own contact details and sends it themselves. Use it when the user wants to ask OwnYourAgent for a proposal.

check_ids.description: Optional Ownership Check IDs (from get_ownership_check) the user wants OwnYourAgent to review, e.g. ["E-02","E-03"].

lang.description: Language of the form: nl (default) or en.

phase.description: Starting phase: kansenrapport (AI opportunity report), pilot, implementatie (implementation) or beheer (management).

topic.description: The work the agent should help with: facturen (invoices and orders), klantvragen (customer questions), telefoon (phone), kennis (internal knowledge), offertes (quotations) or anders (other).

name: prepare_intake_link
title: Prepare an OwnYourAgent request link
